description.value:
Prerequisites: Cleric 14

A cleric can unleash a 30-foot burst of pure, white light as a standard action. evil creatures within this burst take 1d6 points of damage for every two cleric levels and are blinded for 1 round. Evil dragons, evil outsiders, and evil undead are blinded for 1d4 rounds on a failed save. A Reflex save (DC 10 + half the cleric's + his Charisma modifier) halves this damage and negates the blindness. Good creatures within this burst are healed 1d6 points of damage per two cleric levels and receive a +2 sacred bonus on ability checks, attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks for 1 round. A cleric can use this ability once per day at 14th level plus one additional time per day at 17th and 20th levels.
